method: Re-read the five door-affected local review PNGs at native and enlarged sizes after widening. The two footprint sheets remain byte-identical to their previously inspected versions. Static visual inspection only.
observations: Door revision: the measured continuous N/S opening is 20px at x=6..25, with 2.08px total clearance against the supplied 17.92px collision diameter.
Closed door fills the entire 20px gap; open door keeps pixel-identical jambs and a side-swung leaf behind the west jamb. Wall-edge interfaces remain unchanged.
Walls read as thin connected strips with metal caps and stone courses, separate from floor tiles.
Combustion chamber, flue stack, feedwater pump and steam cylinder/flywheel have distinct silhouettes.
The engine flywheel reads round after scaling the normalized source to its 3x2 footprint.
Room examples are composed from individual floor, wall and door frames; the interior remains visible and no whole-building runtime sprite is supplied.
Native and enlarged contacts show crisp pixel boundaries on checker, light and dark grounds.
Only machine_31 and door_open changed; the other 23 frame hashes and the atlas layout JSON are unchanged.
limits: Unity import and live game rendering were not run.
Movement, collisions, interactive doors, rotations, module connections and roof hiding require main-agent integration verification.
